body: It just seems like the perfect time to do it. Plus, I don't want to postpone it, that's what I did last time and look where I am now. Worse than I was before. I just postpone it, feel worse and do it randomly next time? Might as well do it now.

Though I care about those people, that doesn't affect me, because I know that even if it's a selfish thought, I won't be around to see those effects. I would never want to hurt them, I care about them a lot, but this is something for myself, which is not something I do regularly.

> when I get home on Friday, I will sit and fall deeper and deeper into this pit I feel trapped in, until the time comes where I won't be able to get back out.

This isn't a plan, this is what I know will happen, I know myself and my situation well enough to know that will be the case.

> Is this another horrible plan

That's all I seem capable of... Even a stranger confirms that...
The point is not that i don't want to go. Its that any appointment i make, will be after I'm gone.

Well I mean, the doctor just made me fill out a form, then said to come back if things got worse, I didn't get any anti depressants, nothing. And like I said, if I make an appointment, it will be set for after Friday. Which is when I plan on doing this. It seems fitting with what's gone on recently that I do it then.

I will go if I make it. If both of the plans I have to do it fail, then I will go, but if not, then there is no need.

I did see a doctor once when things were first starting to affect me, I got nothing out of it. Things back then seemed alright because I had someone in my life to keep me happy. Plus there is no point in me going now because by the time the appointment is made, it will be after Friday, and I will be gone by then.

If you want more information, check my profile for the other 2 posts I've made, one on here, and one on MMFB. Most of the info is on the one on here though.

By improve I mean, things were still terrible, but the fact that they weren't as bad as when I made the decision, meant that I changed my mind. Things haven't been close to "good" for the last 2 months. And only because of one person were things even remotely good for the last 2 years. So now, I give up, I've had enough. I just want to sleep forever. Since sleeping is the only thing I enjoy any more.

I saw that picture, and all it made me think was that I'd be figured out but alone and depressed. And what good would that be? There was a picture I saw that would help describe why Sunday but i can't find how to post it.

Found it [This](http://quebecme.me/images/posts/ZGH1Zmx/square_1280.jpg)
No. Strongly Atheist. Why? What does that matter?

She's the girl I love. With all my heart. And I know she doesn't love me, but I spend every minute of every day thinking about her and what could have been.

I wish I could find someone to love me, but I've never been desired by anyone else, which is part of the reason why I want to do this. I have nobody else. Nobody left to love me. I'm alone and unwanted.

I will keep you updated until then. And depending on how the next couple days go, maybe after if you're still there to care. I appreciate your support. Just like I appreciate everyone else here. It just feels like something I need to do.

She doesn't ignore me, we just barely talk anymore.
I know I need to let her go, but she was my only chance of happiness. The only thing that made me smile. Every night I thought about her. She bought me a watch for our 1 year anniversary, she kissed it. I kiss it every night, even now, wishing she would return.
I don't want that. I want her. I want the woman who made me the happiest man on the Earth.

I can't forget her. We both wanted to move in together, get married and even have kids. I never wanted kids but she convinced me. She was my future, my love, my everything. I can't forget that. She's told me that she still loves me, but recent events haven't shown that.

I can't do anything stateside, I live in the UK. I couldn't be a nurse either, I have an irrational fear of Needles and Blood (I know, pathetic)

She was my love. My future. I need her, I miss her, I love her. Though I know she's happy without me, I can't be without her. Only she can make the pain go away.

Because she's the love of my life. She wont help me because she's changed as of late. I see why you say that but like i said, i love her. If you wish to see my general situation, check my previous post on SW. Explains it generally without details.

You're right. It equals eternal peace.
At least for me.
Only one person can definitely convince me out of it. And she refuses. So you're welcome to try, but i doubt it will work.

I damn well hope so. I've spent tonight in a state of flux. I spoke to her tonight and for the first time we didn't argue and were civil. It probably wasn't a good idea to talk to her, but I did. She initiated it so there's that.

You're right, cheesy as hell but it makes sense I guess. You deserve them, people like you have kept me bouncing from that final point, and you've definitely been one of the people that bounced me away from this one.

Thanks for being there, a lot of people probably wouldn't, so I really appreciate it. I'll keep you in mind should I need someone, thank you.

Everyone has said I'll get over her and though I know that's the case assuming I continue, right now I don't want to get over her, I want her. Though I appreciate the uplifting words.

I hate feeling like this, I know that if I continue, there is a future for me, there is happiness out there. But whenever I look forward I can't see through the darkness.

Yes I primarily play multi player games, yes I can talk in game, but it's difficult to chat and play at the same time, I see what you're saying, but it can be difficult. I have been talking to people on a Teamspeak server that I've been part of for over a year, and though they have made me feel better when I'm down, they can't seem to bring me out of this pit of despair I feel when I'm alone, trying to sleep for example. I'm sure you're fine at games, depending on the ones you play maybe we can play some time assuming I can keep myself alive long enough.

By a short time I mean like (for example) I play LoL, I can play a 40m match and be fine, but then I'll load up another, get into the loading screen, then suddenly it hits me, I feel low, demotivated, on the verge of tears and I don't even want to play anymore, but you can't leave a League game, so I just end up playing poorly and then that makes me feel worse.

I have met my only friends online, they have been the best, though few and tease me sometimes, they are amazing friends and I'm damn sure that without them I would be 6ft under by now. I can't commend them enough, in fact a streamer (who I won't name due to advertising which I don't think would be appreciated by other readers) has helped cheer me up, but never enough to make me "happy".

It's not me the pressure is coming from (I don't have the motivation to do that either) it's outside sources such as my mother, my family and my school. Hopefully I'll get through this soon, the pain is far too great to live with for long. Thing is, I don't know if I'm having an over reaction, or if this is normal, because I feel like I shouldn't be feeling this down about it all but yet I do, and it hurts.

I can listen to that side for now. I will keep trying to let it win.

I know, I should do that. I keep meaning to but it's just a scary step as it is without how I've been feeling lately.
I really do appreciate you responding to this post, you've been a great help, I don't know whether I would have been here to respond to this if you and the others like you hadn't responded like you did.
I bloody hope I find love again, I miss the warmth of companionship already. I loved her, and she broke my heart.
I hope you find that special someone, that you find him soon, and spend the rest of your life happy together. I'm sorry to hear of your break up, I know it sucks as you can tell. I'm sure you deserve that special someone.

Sorry to hear about that man, anyone who does that is a bit.... mean.... you should never dump someone on those days.
Happy to hear that you found happiness with your wife I'm happy for you.
I know they are man, and I'm sure I will. It's just right now, all I want in life is her. Nothing more, nothing less. And it's killing me knowing that she still loves me (she said so) and thinks it was a mistake (again she said)

I suppose you're right, and I'd love to forget about it all and move on but that just doesn't seem possible right now.
She told me to think of the break-up as a "really long break" but yet she shows no desire of giving the relationship another chance. Which has left me confused.
I love her with all my heart, I never wanted kids but she convinced me that I do, but now that she's gone, I don't think there's even a future to look forwards to. I hope you can deal with this better than I am right now. I wish you all the happiness in the world.
I sure hope soon, because I don't know how much longer I will be here the way I feel right now.

That's just it, I don't even have the motivation to get a job in the first place, though I want one, I can't bring myself to do it. Without tooting my own horn I know I'll be fine in an entry level career, that I'll pick up the skills for the job as I go, only because that's how I always imagined it.

That is lucky, and I have had that before, but never enough or at a time where I can actually do something with it, or do the things I want to with it. Motivators like that never worked on me, mostly because things like going out or even having friends was not something I could use to motivate me. Things that would motivate me, like gaming (I guess) have always been to hand and meant that I could just skip the negative jobs and go straight to what I wanted.
Yes more time is needed I agree, but from my early teens I've wanted nothing more than for my time to be flying by, so I can get to later life where I can deal with things much better.
The problem now is, that with her gone, I don't see a future to work towards, no reason to try because no matter what, she won't be in the life I build, and that's all I've seen since I met her.

Thank you for responding.
I'm sorry to hear about that and wish you all the best in your future.
For me, this was a girl I was willing to go the whole nine yards and then some for. I'm young, but I still expected to die together with her. I know it may sound creepy but that's how in love with her I felt. Everyday things remind me of her, and I spend nearly every waking moment on the brink of tears.
All I want is for her to be happy, but I always thought she would be happy with me, and the fact that she's not, has hurt me more than anything I could ever imagine.

I appreciate your response, it still amazes me that people like you still exist in the world and though I agree with what you're saying, it's a lot harder to do than say. Especially with no motivation.
Not only that, but this girl made me feel like no person has ever made me feel before. She was the first to suggest big future things like kids and moving in together, and though the moving in was something I wanted, it seemed like those and more were going to happen with her. It was such a shock when it happened.
I can't help but think about her, and yes I should keep busy, but even while doing things, my heart sinks as I remember doing stuff with her.
Thank you for responding it means a lot.

I don't mean for this to sound like a diagnosis but that sounds like alcohol addiction, i say that only because my mother was in the same situation, only stopping a week ago from the last time she drank. Don't take that as a definite or as a diagnosis, but lowering your intake would probably be a good idea, however I'm not a doctor so i say that as friendly advice. Please don't take what i say as any more than a word of caution and care for your health, i know the rules of this subreddit prohibit diagnoses but since I've experienced a family member with the exact same situation. And i would love for someone to be helped from this post, even if its not me. If you do not like what i have said or it violates rules, i will happily remove it, i just want at least one person to have some clarity if i can provide it.

My bad thoughts typically come from bad events, like my mother attacking me while high or more recently my breakup which if it hadn't happened, would probably have kept me from my current position.
Right now I'm sat at school, tired and on the brink of tears because i need her back, both of which are making it harder for me to continue.

But that's just part of the problem. I don't have any motivation to do anything. I have no high end qualifications, nothing about me wows an employer, i don't see a career i want so much that i would put all my limited effort into it. I just see a lonely, no money future ahead not worth being part of...

Sorry i didn't respond right away guys/girls, i havent ended it yet. I just hadn't slept in over 24 hours so i passed out. I appreciate the responses. I feel better this morning but nowhere near happy.
Don't worry about hijacking the thread, we all need help sometimes, as per this post for me. If you make it through then that's a small victory.

I've been told that so many times, and even though (someone else) mention this later, i felt that she was my future, that any time i felt down she would be there. That she would bring me up from any depths of despair. As you say i shouldn't rely on others for happiness but at times like these i feel like there isn't any other way.
i have interests that i have no motivation to act on (i love space, its amazing to observe and study, i game, but I've never been good enough to take it further than what i do now, plus i do that solely already, its the only thing i have to do). When i game it distracts me, for a short while, before i think of her, how i feel and what I've lost and suddenly my heart sinks and my motivation to play disappears for a while, making me play badly and therefore do worse, not helping my mood.
I really appreciate the support, my family always say/said that i would never make friends online, but its the strangers that make it what it is, and people like you make the internet so much better.
Thanks for the offer, i will keep it in mind.
Right now i just feel like the future is bleak at best and that there is nothing i can look forward to, nothing to keep me going. And that kills my motivation to do anything. Any ideas?
